checks: Verified original §§1–2. The normalized positive weights cancel the continuous normal, and the common-source equations yield the weighted margin b_g·(z−z_g). In the full-rank case the margin image is the entire affine hyperplane of that weighted sum.

Each shared cap has one coefficient tuple across every incidence. Product differentiation preserves both mixed factors 2u_j′·x_g′ and 2ρ_gj′u_j′, and projected drift contains the separate 2ρ_gj′a_j′ term.

The signs on tight rows follow from one-sided Taylor expansion, while a two-sided path forces zero first coefficient. Fixed first jets leave an affine system in the accelerations. The stated dual has the correct signs for A q=a and B q≥b.

The fixed invertible equality minor corrects the polynomial trial by o(s²), since its exact residual is of that order along the prescribed C² source path. This preserves jets, strict first or second slack, and positive weights. Identity rows impose no constraint and a nonidentity zero jet has no guaranteed sign.

readability: The sufficient realization uses a full-row-rank equality map in the chosen free coefficient variables. A gauge can be built into the chart or imposed as an equality on ambient coefficient variables. The strict slack condition is essential for nonidentity rows.
